summary: Clearmind Medicine Inc., a Vancouver-domiciled, Israeli-operated pharmaceutical issuer, filed a Form 6-K announcing delivery of a notice to its CLA Investors under amended September 17, 2025 securities purchase agreements. The notice triggers issuance of convertible promissory notes totaling $2.0 million principal for cash consideration of 90% of principal, or $1.8 million, part of a previously authorized up-to-$10.0 million facility. Closing is expected on or before October 19, 2026. No board recommendation or advisor is named. This is a routine, pre-agreed private-placement drawdown, not a special situation; watch conversion pricing and dilution overhang, not deal arbitrage.
